title: Countable infinite sets admit bijections
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S,T$ be infinite sets [def-sfb-finite-infinite-set] that are at most countable [def-sfb-countable-set], meaning each admits an injection into $\mathbb N$. There exists a bijection $S\to T$. In particular, for each such $T$ there is a bijection $\mathbb N\to T$.
